ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Use the shoelace formula with vertices in the given order: A(3,2), B(3,-2), C(-3,-2), D(-3,0). Compute the first diagonal sum: 3(-2) + 3(-2) + (-3)(0) + (-3)(2) = -6 - 6 + 0 - 6 = -18. Compute the second diagonal sum: 2(3) + (-2)(-3) + (-2)(-3) + 0(3) = 6 + 6 + 6 + 0 = 18. The area is one half the absolute difference: (1/2)|-18 - 18| = (1/2)(36) = 18.

Apply the trapezoid area formula: area = ((4+2)/2)*6 = 18.
